Copy: region cards no longer show "High demand"/"Limited"; the preselect note no longer says "almost out of space"; capacity reasons in `lib/capacity.ts` no longer say "at capacity"; the custom server builder is a normal option (tile "Your exact vCPU, RAM & disk · Same checkout as any plan"; game banner "Want more power than these tiers?"), capacity never sends it to a sales ticket (`createCustomPlan` no longer throws `CustomPlanCapacityError`), and the "tell us the size" card only appears at the top of a slider.

**Payment records (`lib/payment-events.ts`).** Every payment event becomes an `ActivityEvent` (category `payment`) with customer, amount, currency, method, country and outcome:
- every Stripe Checkout Session the app opens goes through `createCheckoutSessionLogged()` → `payment.checkout_opened`;
- the Stripe webhook records `checkout.session.completed` (succeeded, or `payment.pending` for a delayed local method), `async_payment_succeeded/failed`, `checkout.session.expired`, `payment_intent.payment_failed` (decline code, card country, brand, funding, 3-D Secure flag), `payment_intent.requires_action`, `payment_intent.succeeded` (off-session only), `charge.refunded`, `charge.dispute.created/closed` (plus an URGENT admin notification for a new dispute). Idempotent on `stripe:<event id>`; resolves the customer from metadata, the Stripe customer id, or the PaymentIntent's session;
- off-session charges (renewal sweep, admin Renew now, auto-recharge, hosting renewals) are recorded inside `chargeSavedCardOffSession()` (success shares the key `pi:<id>:succeeded` with the webhook);
- wallet renewals (`commitRenewal`), dunning steps (declined attempt, card unusable, re-add-card notice, suspended, terminated), admin refunds (key `refund:<re_id>`, shared with `charge.refunded`), PayPal / Coinbase checkout opened, capture failures and successes (`fulfilExternalPayment`).
The admin Billing page lists the webhook events to enable (`STRIPE_LOGGED_EVENTS`).

**Local payment methods (checked 2026-10-06).** None are enabled in production (no `pay_method_*` settings, no `stripe_account_country`, no FX rates), so no customer in India, Indonesia, Singapore or Bangladesh is offered UPI/PayNow/GrabPay today. When enabled, the wizard and Add-funds show every enabled method to everyone (no per-country filter); UPI covers IN, PayNow/GrabPay SG (GrabPay also MY); nothing exists for ID (QRIS) or BD (bKash).

**Activity record (`ActivityEvent`, one additive table).** Writer: `lib/activity-events.ts` `recordActivity()` (worker-safe, never throws, sanitises `data`, truncates IPs to /24 or /48, strips query strings from routes) and `lib/activity-request.ts` `recordRequestActivity()` (adds truncated IP, country, device, impersonating admin). Typed catalogue `ACTIVITY_TYPES` (categories page · wizard · payment · action · error · auth; only `client: true` types are accepted from the browser). Browser beacon: `lib/activity-client.ts` (batched every 5 s / 20 events / pagehide, 300 per tab) → `POST /api/activity` (signed-in customers only, never while impersonating, 40 batches/min per account, labels built server-side by `lib/activity-client-labels.ts`). Recorded: deploy-wizard choices (product, game, plan, term, region, OS, variant, disk, add-ons, coupon, wallet, hosting/email plan — one observer in `components/nx/order.tsx`), wizard open / submit / abandon (step they left on), errors shown on the payment step and error pages, stale-client events, console and web-terminal opens, file-manager operations (operation only, at most once per 10 min), ticket open/reply and live chat use (never the text), billing preference changes, sign-up / sign-in / failed sign-in (existing accounts only) / sign-out / email verified / password reset (email, Google, Discord). Page views and wizard steps are NOT duplicated: they already live in `Visit` and `DeployFunnelEvent` and are merged on read. Retention: `activity_retention_days` (default 180), worker sweep `activity-prune` (6 h). GDPR self-deletion deletes the rows. New per-user indexes on `Visit`, `AuditLog`, `DeployFunnelEvent`. `/api/track/deploy-step` no longer attributes events to a customer while an admin impersonates them.

**Read side (`lib/activity-timeline.ts`).** `loadActivityTimeline(userId, {categories, days, limit})` merges ActivityEvent + AuditLog + Visit + DeployFunnelEvent into one `TimelineItem[]`; `loadWizardProgress(userId)` gives per product: sessions, furthest step, reached payment, completed count, drop point, last configuration, last errors; `loadPaymentRecords(userId)`. input.message:
## Signup fixes, capacity queue, payment records and activity timeline: built, not deployed

Branch `feature/signup-fixes-activity`, worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-signupfix`. Nothing was merged or deployed. `main` and `/opt/nxeon` are untouched (main is still at b23bc8e8d5). No emails were sent, and the prod DB was only read (SELECT). The project's commit hook may have pushed the branch to origin.

Commits:
- `2cd34aaf04` Honest /free-vps and /free-minecraft pages with a real next step.
- `55942cd41d` Capacity queue, payment records, activity timeline, and the stale-state fixes.
- `7805d9a61c` Leaving the page right after pressing Pay is no longer logged as abandonment.

**Testing.** `tsc` is clean. New tests pass: `test/activity-events.test.ts` (11), `test/payment-events.test.ts` (9, including real Stripe signature checks against the webhook route and a redelivery test), `test/signup-fixes.test.ts` (5). I updated `test/region-pick.test.ts` (13 pass). I also ran about 40 related existing suites. The ones that fail (checkout-fulfilment, checkout-metadata, customer-actions-guards, admin-console-guards, pricing-display-vs-charge, purchase-consent, promo-race, proration, auth-lockouts) fail the same way on an untouched copy of main, so they were already broken.

**I did not run the app.** Free memory was 2–8 GB all session, so I ran no dev server and no `next build`. The screenshots in `/root/agent-notes/signup-fixes/` are static renders of the regenerated landing pages and the refresh bar only. They have no fonts, page scripts or animations; for example the second H1 line is invisible because it only appears via animation. The deploy wizard, custom builder and admin Activity tab still need a look on staging.

## 1. Quick fixes

**Free-intent landing pages** (edited in the generator wire modules, loaders and SEO registry, then regenerated with `port_pages.py`; audit says "wired"):
- **/free-vps** now says plainly there is no free VPS tier and names what is free: a no-card account and the free Minecraft server.
  - The hero and final buttons are "Deploy a VPS from $8.88" (cheapest real plan) and "Get a free Minecraft server".
  - All "free credit" promises are gone from the steps, the trial comparison, the FAQ and the page script.
  - New title: "Free VPS? No-Card Sign-Up, Real VPS from {price}/mo".
- **/free-minecraft** now says Java Edition (the free tier has no Bedrock support). It adds a FAQ "Can Bedrock players join?" pointing to the real cheapest Bedrock tier, and the title includes "(Java)".

**Stale "large download" step and missing ready email.**
- Cause: only the normal provisioning success path ever cleared the step text or sent the ready email. The two Oct 2 servers both failed provisioning 3/3. Something flipped them to RUNNING between 02:26 and 02:27; there is no audit row and no START job, so it was not a normal action path. A game reinstall then confirmed the game port at about 02:28, and both kept the stale step.
- Fix: a new `lib/server-ready.ts` runs on every other way into RUNNING: game reinstall, power start, admin reconcile, restore, and the sandbox path. It clears the stale text.
- The ready email only goes out when the game was confirmed up (the reinstall port check), the server never finished setup, and it is under 30 days old. It uses the existing deduped sender. A plain start never emails.
- A 15-minute watchdog clears the text on idle RUNNING servers and sends one admin notification. It sends no email.

**"Failed to find Server Action" after deploys.**
- The error is now detected globally (`components/StaleClientGuard.tsx`, mounted in `app/layout.tsx`).
- If the customer hasn't typed anything, the page refreshes itself once. Otherwise it shows "A new version of Nxeon is available — Refresh".
- Error pages also auto-reload for it, and the deploy wizard and support page report it from their error handlers.

**/dashboard/support 500s on Oct 4.** These were the ticket polls (every 3 s and 1.2 s) throwing "unauthorized" after the session expired. They now answer "signed out" and the page stops polling.

**/api/chat/upload 500s on Oct 1.** These were nginx failing to write request bodies to its temp directory (permission denied). That was fixed at the server level before today and is not a code bug. I noticed the route also reloads every image in the conversation on each upload, and flagged that as a separate task.

**Hosting/email wizard domain.** The domain is now validated at the Site/Mailboxes step, with an inline "Enter a valid domain (e.g. example.com)." message. A pasted `https://`, path or port is cleaned off before submitting.

**Unverified-email banner.** It already existed, but said "you can't place an order until it's confirmed" while the purchase gate (`email_verification_enforced`) is off in prod. The copy now follows that setting. It is still in-app only.

## 2. Capacity: orders are always accepted

- **Orders are always accepted in the chosen region.** This covers four cases: no RAM headroom across the fleet, no node in the region (which includes the live RAM guard in enforce mode), a full disk pool, or a custom size.
- **When there's no room, the order is queued for setup.** It is charged and created with no node and no provisioning job.
- **The customer sees:** "Your server is being prepared. We'll email you the moment it's ready, usually within 24 hours." The hours come from a new setting, `setup_queue_expected_hours`.
- **Staff get an URGENT alert** naming the region, size and customer. It goes to every admin's notifications, to the error log (which also posts to the error webhook), and to the admin tray as "URGENT: N paid orders waiting for capacity".
- **A worker sweep places queued orders** every 3 minutes through the same guards, oldest first. It then starts provisioning and pushes the expiry date out by the time spent waiting, so customers don't pay for queue time. The normal ready email follows.
- **No node is ever filled past the RAM guard.** Queued orders don't count against the primary's committed RAM.
- **RAM-guard refusals now log the user id**, region and product.
- **Pre-payment checks no longer refuse a full region.** Only a region we don't operate at all is refused.
- **Scarcity copy removed:** the "High demand" / "Limited" region badges, "almost out of space", and "at capacity".
- **The custom builder now reads as a normal option.** The tile says "Your exact vCPU, RAM & disk / Same checkout as any plan". The game banner says "Want more power than these tiers?". Capacity never diverts it to a sales ticket, and a "tell us the size" card appears only at the top of a slider.

## 3. Payment records

Every payment event is recorded with customer, amount, currency, method, country and outcome:
- **Checkout opened:** for all 19 places the app opens a Stripe checkout, plus PayPal and Coinbase.
- **Stripe webhook:**
  - Checkout completed, recorded as pending for delayed local methods.
  - Async payment succeeded or failed.
  - Checkout expired.
  - Payment failed, with decline code, card country, brand, funding and a 3-D Secure flag.
  - Payment needs 3-D Secure.
  - Saved-card charge succeeded.
  - Refunds.
  - Disputes opened or closed. A new dispute also sends an URGENT admin notification.
- **Saved-card charges:** renewal sweep, admin Renew now, auto-recharge and hosting renewals, all recorded in one place.
- **Other:** wallet renewals, dunning steps (declined, card unusable, re-add-card notice, suspended, terminated), admin refunds, PayPal capture failures, and PayPal/Coinbase successes.
- **No double-counting:** webhook rows are deduplicated on the Stripe event id. Records that two sources can write (worker and webhook, admin refund and webhook) share one key.

**Local payment methods: none appear for India, Indonesia, Singapore or Bangladesh today.** Prod has no `pay_method_*` settings, no `stripe_account_country` and no FX rates.
- **If enabled:** UPI would cover India, and PayNow/GrabPay Singapore.
- **Not implemented:** nothing exists for Indonesia (QRIS) or Bangladesh (bKash).
- **No country filter:** the wizard and Add-funds would show every enabled method to every customer.

## 4–5. Activity tracking and the admin page

- **Recorded:**
  - Deploy-wizard choices: product, game, plan, term, region, OS, server type, disk, add-ons, coupon, wallet, hosting/email plan.
  - Wizard opened, Pay pressed, and the step where they left.
  - Errors shown on the payment step and error pages, and the stale-version event.
  - Console and web-terminal opens.
  - File-manager use (which operation only, at most once per 10 minutes).
  - Ticket open/reply and live chat use (never the text).
  - Billing preference changes.
  - Sign-up, sign-in and failed sign-in (existing accounts only), sign-out, email verified, password reset, for email, Google and Discord.
- **Page visits and wizard steps** were already recorded per user, so I read those existing tables instead of logging them twice.
- **Privacy safeguards:**
  - Never stored: passwords, file contents, keystrokes, card data or message text.
  - IPs are shortened before storage.
  - The browser beacon is first-party, batched, rate-limited, and only accepts browser-safe event types.
  - Nothing is recorded while staff impersonate a customer. I also stopped the existing wizard-step tracker from attributing steps to the customer during impersonation.
- **Retention:** 180 days by default, with a prune job. Self-service account deletion also deletes the rows.
- **Admin:** the customer page has a new "Activity timeline" tab (the old tab is now "Security & sessions"). It has three parts:
  - Per-product deploy-wizard progress: furthest step, where they dropped, last configuration, recent errors.
  - A payment records table.
  - A timeline filterable by Pages / Deploy wizard / Payments / Actions / Errors / Sign-in and by 7/30/90/180 days, with the existing audit log merged in.

## Event schema (for the Reports agent)

One additive table, `ActivityEvent`, written only through `recordActivity()` in `lib/activity-events.ts` (worker-safe, never throws). Web code uses `recordRequestActivity()` in `lib/activity-request.ts`, which adds IP, country, device and the impersonating admin.

Columns:

| Group | Columns |
|---|---|
| Identity | `id`, `createdAt`, `userId?`, `visitorId?`, `sessionId?` |
| What | `category`, `type`, `label?` |
| Where | `route?`, `referrer?`, `serverId?` |
| Payment | `provider?`, `method?`, `outcome?`, `amountCents?`, `currency?` (lowercase), `country?`, `reference?` |
| Idempotency | `dedupeKey?` (unique) |
| Page / device | `durationMs?`, `deviceType?`, `os?`, `browser?`, `ipPrefix?` |
| Other | `actorAdminId?`, `data?` (Json) |

- **`category`** is one of: page, wizard, payment, action, error, auth.
- **`outcome`** is one of: opened, succeeded, pending, failed, requires_action, cancelled, expired, refunded, disputed.
- **Indexes:** (userId, createdAt), (category, createdAt), (type, createdAt), (createdAt).
- **No foreign key to User**, on purpose, so a payment record for a since-deleted user is never lost.

**Event types** (`ACTIVITY_TYPES`; † = accepted from the browser):
- **Page:** `page.view`†
- **Wizard:** `wizard.open`†, `wizard.step`†, `wizard.field`†, `wizard.submit`†, `wizard.abandon`†, `wizard.queued`
- **Payment:** `payment.checkout_opened`, `payment.checkout_closed`†, `payment.checkout_expired`, `payment.succeeded`, `payment.pending`, `payment.failed`, `payment.requires_action`, `payment.refunded`, `payment.dispute_opened`, `payment.dispute_closed`, `payment.topup`, `payment.renewal`, `payment.dunning`
- **Action:** `action.power`, `action.console_opened`, `action.terminal_opened`, `action.files`, `action.mod`, `action.settings`, `action.ticket`, `action.chat`, `action.billing`, `action.ui`†
- **Error:** `error.shown`†, `error.stale_client`†
- **Auth:** `auth.signup`, `auth.login`, `auth.login_failed`, `auth.logout`, `auth.verify_email`, `auth.password_reset_request`, `auth.password_reset`

Not every catalogue type has a writer yet. `page.view`, `wizard.step`, `action.power`, `action.mod`, `action.settings`, `payment.topup`, `payment.checkout_closed` and `action.ui` are never written today. Pages and wizard steps come from the existing visit and funnel tables. Power, mod and settings changes already reach the timeline through the audit log. Top-ups are recorded as `payment.succeeded` with `data.purpose = "topup"`.

**Read API** (`lib/activity-timeline.ts`):
- `loadActivityTimeline(userId, {categories, days, limit})` merges ActivityEvent, AuditLog, Visit and DeployFunnelEvent into one `TimelineItem[]`.

## Signup fixes, capacity queue, payment records and activity timeline: built, not deployed

Branch `feature/signup-fixes-activity`, worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-signupfix`. Nothing was merged or deployed. `main` and `/opt/nxeon` are untouched (main is still at b23bc8e8d5). No emails were sent, and the prod DB was only read (SELECT). The project's commit hook may have pushed the branch to origin.

Commits:
- `2cd34aaf04` Honest /free-vps and /free-minecraft pages with a real next step.
- `55942cd41d` Capacity queue, payment records, activity timeline, and the stale-state fixes.
- `7805d9a61c` Leaving the page right after pressing Pay is no longer logged as abandonment.

**Testing.** `tsc` is clean. New tests pass: `test/activity-events.test.ts` (11), `test/payment-events.test.ts` (9, including real Stripe signature checks against the webhook route and a redelivery test), `test/signup-fixes.test.ts` (5). I updated `test/region-pick.test.ts` (13 pass). I also ran about 40 related existing suites. The ones that fail (checkout-fulfilment, checkout-metadata, customer-actions-guards, admin-console-guards, pricing-display-vs-charge, purchase-consent, promo-race, proration, auth-lockouts) fail the same way on an untouched copy of main, so they were already broken.

**I did not run the app.** Free memory was 2–8 GB all session, so I ran no dev server and no `next build`. The screenshots in `/root/agent-notes/signup-fixes/` are static renders of the regenerated landing pages and the refresh bar only. They have no fonts, page scripts or animations; for example the second H1 line is invisible because it only appears via animation. The deploy wizard, custom builder and admin Activity tab still need a look on staging.

## 1. Quick fixes

**Free-intent landing pages** (edited in the generator wire modules, loaders and SEO registry, then regenerated with `port_pages.py`; audit says "wired"):
- **/free-vps** now says plainly there is no free VPS tier and names what is free: a no-card account and the free Minecraft server.
  - The hero and final buttons are "Deploy a VPS from $8.88" (cheapest real plan) and "Get a free Minecraft server".
  - All "free credit" promises are gone from the steps, the trial comparison, the FAQ and the page script.
  - New title: "Free VPS? No-Card Sign-Up, Real VPS from {price}/mo".
- **/free-minecraft** now says Java Edition (the free tier has no Bedrock support). It adds a FAQ "Can Bedrock players join?" pointing to the real cheapest Bedrock tier, and the title includes "(Java)".

**Stale "large download" step and missing ready email.**
- Cause: only the normal provisioning success path ever cleared the step text or sent the ready email. The two Oct 2 servers both failed provisioning 3/3. Something flipped them to RUNNING between 02:26 and 02:27; there is no audit row and no START job, so it was not a normal action path. A game reinstall then confirmed the game port at about 02:28, and both kept the stale step.
- Fix: a new `lib/server-ready.ts` runs on every other way into RUNNING: game reinstall, power start, admin reconcile, restore, and the sandbox path. It clears the stale text.
- The ready email only goes out when the game was confirmed up (the reinstall port check), the server never finished setup, and it is under 30 days old. It uses the existing deduped sender. A plain start never emails.
- A 15-minute watchdog clears the text on idle RUNNING servers and sends one admin notification. It sends no email.

**"Failed to find Server Action" after deploys.**
- The error is now detected globally (`components/StaleClientGuard.tsx`, mounted in `app/layout.tsx`).
- If the customer hasn't typed anything, the page refreshes itself once. Otherwise it shows "A new version of Nxeon is available — Refresh".
- Error pages also auto-reload for it, and the deploy wizard and support page report it from their error handlers.

**/dashboard/support 500s on Oct 4.** These were the ticket polls (every 3 s and 1.2 s) throwing "unauthorized" after the session expired. They now answer "signed out" and the page stops polling.

**/api/chat/upload 500s on Oct 1.** These were nginx failing to write request bodies to its temp directory (permission denied). That was fixed at the server level before today and is not a code bug. I noticed the route also reloads every image in the conversation on each upload, and flagged that as a separate task.

**Hosting/email wizard domain.** The domain is now validated at the Site/Mailboxes step, with an inline "Enter a valid domain (e.g. example.com)." message. A pasted `https://`, path or port is cleaned off before submitting.

**Unverified-email banner.** It already existed, but said "you can't place an order until it's confirmed" while the purchase gate (`email_verification_enforced`) is off in prod. The copy now follows that setting. It is still in-app only.

## 2. Capacity: orders are always accepted

- **Orders are always accepted in the chosen region.** This covers four cases: no RAM headroom across the fleet, no node in the region (which includes the live RAM guard in enforce mode), a full disk pool, or a custom size.
- **When there's no room, the order is queued for setup.** It is charged and created with no node and no provisioning job.
- **The customer sees:** "Your server is being prepared. We'll email you the moment it's ready, usually within 24 hours." The hours come from a new setting, `setup_queue_expected_hours`.
- **Staff get an URGENT alert** naming the region, size and customer. It goes to every admin's notifications, to the error log (which also posts to the error webhook), and to the admin tray as "URGENT: N paid orders waiting for capacity".
- **A worker sweep places queued orders** every 3 minutes through the same guards, oldest first. It then starts provisioning and pushes the expiry date out by the time spent waiting, so customers don't pay for queue time. The normal ready email follows.
- **No node is ever filled past the RAM guard.** Queued orders don't count against the primary's committed RAM.
- **RAM-guard refusals now log the user id**, region and product.
- **Pre-payment checks no longer refuse a full region.** Only a region we don't operate at all is refused.
- **Scarcity copy removed:** the "High demand" / "Limited" region badges, "almost out of space", and "at capacity".
- **The custom builder now reads as a normal option.** The tile says "Your exact vCPU, RAM & disk / Same checkout as any plan". The game banner says "Want more power than these tiers?". Capacity never diverts it to a sales ticket, and a "tell us the size" card appears only at the top of a slider.

## 3. Payment records

Every payment event is recorded with customer, amount, currency, method, country and outcome:
- **Checkout opened:** for all 19 places the app opens a Stripe checkout, plus PayPal and Coinbase.
- **Stripe webhook:**
  - Checkout completed, recorded as pending for delayed local methods.
  - Async payment succeeded or failed.
  - Checkout expired.
  - Payment failed, with decline code, card country, brand, funding and a 3-D Secure flag.
  - Payment needs 3-D Secure.
  - Saved-card charge succeeded.
  - Refunds.
  - Disputes opened or closed. A new dispute also sends an URGENT admin notification.
- **Saved-card charges:** renewal sweep, admin Renew now, auto-recharge and hosting renewals, all recorded in one place.
- **Other:** wallet renewals, dunning steps (declined, card unusable, re-add-card notice, suspended, terminated), admin refunds, PayPal capture failures, and PayPal/Coinbase successes.
- **No double-counting:** webhook rows are deduplicated on the Stripe event id. Records that two sources can write (worker and webhook, admin refund and webhook) share one key.

**Local payment methods: none appear for India, Indonesia, Singapore or Bangladesh today.** Prod has no `pay_method_*` settings, no `stripe_account_country` and no FX rates.
- **If enabled:** UPI would cover India, and PayNow/GrabPay Singapore.
- **Not implemented:** nothing exists for Indonesia (QRIS) or Bangladesh (bKash).
- **No country filter:** the wizard and Add-funds would show every enabled method to every customer.

## 4–5. Activity tracking and the admin page

- **Recorded:**
  - Deploy-wizard choices: product, game, plan, term, region, OS, server type, disk, add-ons, coupon, wallet, hosting/email plan.
  - Wizard opened, Pay pressed, and the step where they left.
  - Errors shown on the payment step and error pages, and the stale-version event.
  - Console and web-terminal opens.
  - File-manager use (which operation only, at most once per 10 minutes).
  - Ticket open/reply and live chat use (never the text).
  - Billing preference changes.
  - Sign-up, sign-in and failed sign-in (existing accounts only), sign-out, email verified, password reset, for email, Google and Discord.
- **Page visits and wizard steps** were already recorded per user, so I read those existing tables instead of logging them twice.
- **Privacy safeguards:**
  - Never stored: passwords, file contents, keystrokes, card data or message text.
  - IPs are shortened before storage.
  - The browser beacon is first-party, batched, rate-limited, and only accepts browser-safe event types.
  - Nothing is recorded while staff impersonate a customer. I also stopped the existing wizard-step tracker from attributing steps to the customer during impersonation.
- **Retention:** 180 days by default, with a prune job. Self-service account deletion also deletes the rows.
- **Admin:** the customer page has a new "Activity timeline" tab (the old tab is now "Security & sessions"). It has three parts:
  - Per-product deploy-wizard progress: furthest step, where they dropped, last configuration, recent errors.
  - A payment records table.
  - A timeline filterable by Pages / Deploy wizard / Payments / Actions / Errors / Sign-in and by 7/30/90/180 days, with the existing audit log merged in.

## Event schema (for the Reports agent)

One additive table, `ActivityEvent`, written only through `recordActivity()` in `lib/activity-events.ts` (worker-safe, never throws). Web code uses `recordRequestActivity()` in `lib/activity-request.ts`, which adds IP, country, device and the impersonating admin.

Columns:

| Group | Columns |
|---|---|
| Identity | `id`, `createdAt`, `userId?`, `visitorId?`, `sessionId?` |
| What | `category`, `type`, `label?` |
| Where | `route?`, `referrer?`, `serverId?` |
| Payment | `provider?`, `method?`, `outcome?`, `amountCents?`, `currency?` (lowercase), `country?`, `reference?` |
| Idempotency | `dedupeKey?` (unique) |
| Page / device | `durationMs?`, `deviceType?`, `os?`, `browser?`, `ipPrefix?` |
| Other | `actorAdminId?`, `data?` (Json) |

- **`category`** is one of: page, wizard, payment, action, error, auth.
- **`outcome`** is one of: opened, succeeded, pending, failed, requires_action, cancelled, expired, refunded, disputed.
- **Indexes:** (userId, createdAt), (category, createdAt), (type, createdAt), (createdAt).
- **No foreign key to User**, on purpose, so a payment record for a since-deleted user is never lost.

**Event types** (`ACTIVITY_TYPES`; † = accepted from the browser):
- **Page:** `page.view`†
- **Wizard:** `wizard.open`†, `wizard.step`†, `wizard.field`†, `wizard.submit`†, `wizard.abandon`†, `wizard.queued`
- **Payment:** `payment.checkout_opened`, `payment.checkout_closed`†, `payment.checkout_expired`, `payment.succeeded`, `payment.pending`, `payment.failed`, `payment.requires_action`, `payment.refunded`, `payment.dispute_opened`, `payment.dispute_closed`, `payment.topup`, `payment.renewal`, `payment.dunning`
- **Action:** `action.power`, `action.console_opened`, `action.terminal_opened`, `action.files`, `action.mod`, `action.settings`, `action.ticket`, `action.chat`, `action.billing`, `action.ui`†
- **Error:** `error.shown`†, `error.stale_client`†
- **Auth:** `auth.signup`, `auth.login`, `auth.login_failed`, `auth.logout`, `auth.verify_email`, `auth.password_reset_request`, `auth.password_reset`

Not every catalogue type has a writer yet. `page.view`, `wizard.step`, `action.power`, `action.mod`, `action.settings`, `payment.topup`, `payment.checkout_closed` and `action.ui` are never written today. Pages and wizard steps come from the existing visit and funnel tables. Power, mod and settings changes already reach the timeline through the audit log.
